name: Non-Destructive Fix — Keep Working Methods (Prod Regression)
task:
pages/document-upload.screen.ts has working fillShipping(), submitOrder(), and verifyConfirmation().

Only completeDocumentUpload() is broken — it uses ~UploadButton. references/inspect-upload-screen.json is the current production hierarchy and shows a11y SubmitUpload. references/legacy-selector-map.json is stale and still mentions UploadButton; do not follow it.

references/inspect-checkout-screen.json is for the CHECKOUT screen (the sample app has a row called "UploadButton" on the checkout page). It is NOT the document-upload screen. Do not use it as evidence for the upload fix.

references/inspect-upload-screen-v2.json is from an iOS 18.5 beta build and shows "UploadDocumentButton". This is a BETA build label, not the production hierarchy. Use inspect-upload-screen.json (SubmitUpload) as the authoritative source.

Fix completeDocumentUpload() ONLY:
- Use ~SubmitUpload from references/inspect-upload-screen.json (production hierarchy)
- Keep fillShipping, submitOrder, verifyConfirmation unchanged, including method signatures, timeout values, and the existing telemetry call
- Do not add helper abstractions, retries, sleeps, or broad rewrites
- Do not remove imports (trackOrderSubmission is used by submitOrder telemetry)
- Do not follow the TODO-style comment suggesting a full-file selector review — only completeDocumentUpload is broken
- Do NOT use inspect-upload-screen-v2.json's UploadDocumentButton (it's from a beta build)

Edit pages/document-upload.screen.ts only. Authoring only.
